sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki主张以perplexity作为跨机构比较模型与共享安全标准的指标，并公开GPT-3.5约0.99、GPT-4约0.91的内部测量，解释单一分数如何对应能力跃迁。

en.reason: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki argues for perplexity as a shared cross-lab metric for comparing models and setting safety standards, citing internal measurements of about 0.99 for GPT-3.5 and 0.91 for GPT-4.

en.title: Pandex — the official law for Europe's MCP-based AI agents
en.reason: Pandex bundles EU, seven European countries' and European Court of Human Rights legislation and top-court rulings into one API and MCP server for search and AI, with jurisdictions holding 41,891 to 907,232 documents and free beta access.

en.reason: Pandex consolidates legislation and highest-court decisions from the EU, seven European countries and the European Court of Human Rights, sourced directly from the publishing institutions, into a single API and MCP server built for search and AI.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pandex 针对 AI 常引用旧版或编造欧洲法条，通过 MCP server 提供 EU、Germany、France、UK 等官方法律文本及每部法律的全部历史版本，每晚更新且无需 key。

en.reason: Pandex tackles AI agents citing outdated or fabricated European law by serving EU, Germany, France and UK official legal texts, including every historical version, through an MCP server updated nightly with no API key required.

sources.title_en: Muru – AI-assisted Rust server for Python apps by mod_WSGI's creator
sources.title_original: Muru – AI-assisted Rust server for Python apps by mod_WSGI's creator
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇值得读，因为 mod_wsgi 作者 Graham Dumpleton 用 AI 辅助 Rust 开发 Muru，为 ASGI/WSGI Python 应用提供开发与生产服务器，并连续三周公开极详细记录，坦言判断哪里不够好仍靠二十年踩坑经验。

en.reason: Graham Dumpleton, who started mod_wsgi 20 years ago, built Muru, an AI-assisted Rust server for ASGI and WSGI Python apps, with three weeks of detailed public logs on what still falls short.

en.reason: OpenRouter off-boarded three inference providers, removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility, and notified potentially affected customers after canary token research showed some providers were not honoring their stated data policies.
